reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: At Ethereum block 26110197 on October 3, 2026, getLatestReserve() returned raw 23791487760000000000000000 (18 decimals), USD 23,791,487.76, matching the observed dashboard NAV. This pins the getter state, not the reserve composition's valuation time: the getter returns no timestamp and the dashboard remains undated. No independently signed reserve-to-liability reconciliation is supplied. Custodian/broker identities, encumbrances and current third-party token deployment identities are undisclosed. Terms permit affiliate reuse and provide no holder asset title.
